title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap **More info** on an item on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Update: the Shenzhen summit ends with a joint **"Declaration toward Peace"** from Trump, Xi and Putin
items.summary_md: The three leaders agreed to hold talks on reducing nuclear risks and stopping the spread of nuclear weapons after a closed-door meeting.

items.headline_md: The UN's top court rules **Myanmar committed genocide** against the Rohingya, the first time it has found a state guilty
items.summary_md: After a three-hour ruling in The Gambia v. Myanmar, the ICJ also found Myanmar failed to prevent and punish genocide in Rakhine state.

items.headline_md: Update: a Houthi strike hits Riyadh's tallest skyscraper, the **PIF Tower** that houses Saudi Arabia's wealth fund
items.summary_md: Saudi civil defense reported damage to several floors and nearby buildings but no injuries; the Houthis also claim attacks on Riyadh's airport and a Jubail petrochemical plant.

items.headline_md: Türkiye's homegrown **Kizilelma** unmanned fighter jet enters military service
items.summary_md: Erdogan announced the milestone, and Baykar says it delivered the first three aircraft.

items.headline_md: Update: **Anthropic** shares slip about **6% to $91.30** premarket a day after jumping 17% in their debut
items.summary_md: The stock is falling back toward its $83 IPO price as the record listing fails to calm the AI sell-off.

items.headline_md: Update: **Walmart** narrowly beats estimates and **raises its full-year outlook**
items.summary_md: Global e-commerce grew 17% and US ads 37%; the CEO says rising diesel costs are being offset partly by tariff refunds.

items.headline_md: **BASF** walks away from its **€11.2B** bid for chemicals rival **Evonik**
items.summary_md: BASF says Evonik showed no meaningful engagement, even with a further moderate raise to its €24-a-share offer on the table.

items.headline_md: **UniCredit** and Germany reach a broad deal on its **Commerzbank** takeover
items.summary_md: The merged German business would stay headquartered and listed in Frankfurt, and Berlin dropped its demand for two supervisory-board seats.

items.headline_md: **GTA VI** sold an estimated **24.58M copies** and about **$2.36B** on day one, per Sensor Tower
items.summary_md: About 75% were on PS5; Rockstar and Take-Two haven't confirmed any figures yet.

items.headline_md: Valve's **512GB Steam Machine** is now on open sale, with no waitlist
items.summary_md: The 2TB model is out of stock, and Valve warns that rising memory and storage costs cloud future supply and pricing.

items.headline_md: **Ubisoft** cuts **166 jobs** in Canada: 128 in Montreal and 38 in Quebec City
items.summary_md: Ubisoft says the cuts hit production teams and support staff, under 4% of its Canadian workforce.

items.headline_md: Hyper-casual: Grand Games joins the **smash-like** race with **Knock And Drop!**, and Hungry Studio's **Rotate Rings** jumps 334% to 14.6M downloads
items.summary_md: Royal Smash sits at $8.9M in IAP, and 72% of Rotate Rings installs came from paid UA.

items.headline_md: **Modern Warfare 4** was October's best-selling US game, per Circana
items.summary_md: Content spending fell 14% year on year, mostly because of mobile.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo. The r/decomps new page has no lifter post, and a GitHub search finds no Wii U recomp repos created since Nov 17. The existing general tools, RebrewU (last push Oct 18) and nWiiURecomp (Aug 5), are older projects, not the announced lifter. GTA VI watch: no credible native-PC recomp or port. No PS5 or Switch 2 commercial-game breakthroughs in the last 24–48 hours.

items.headline_md: **VUEPort**, a new free, open-source **Virtual Boy** (and "VB Color") emulator, launches for browser, desktop, mobile and VR
items.summary_md: Team VUEngine built it on the accurate Shrooms-VB core and runs it at vueport.net.

items.headline_md: **Geartowns 1.0.8** adds a keyboard mapper, Game Focus mode and faster, more accurate 486 emulation for **FM Towns**
items.summary_md: It also improves CRT shaders and fast-forward audio; you still need firmware dumped from your own hardware.

items.headline_md: Nov 19 builds: **PCSX2 v2.9.183**, **RPCS3** v0.0.43 alpha, **Xenia** and Xenia Edge, **Dolphin** 2609-289, **Azahar** 2127.0 rc4, shadPS4 Pre and the **KytyPS5** r261119 dev build
items.summary_md: These are routine dev builds, not announced breakthroughs.

items.headline_md: **r/decomps** adds a rule: **no Switch 2 repo links at all**, on top of its GTA VI repo-link ban
items.summary_md: Both rules are pinned at the top of the subreddit.

items.headline_md: **Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** takes **$21.25M** in previews, the franchise's second-best behind Catching Fire
items.summary_md: That beats Wicked's $19.2M, and Deadline says a $100M opening looks well in store.

items.headline_md: Update: Lionsgate projects **$80M+**, but sources tell THR that Sunrise could reach **$100M–$130M** from 3,900 theaters
items.summary_md: The film cost roughly $150M; Joseph Zada plays young Haymitch.

items.headline_md: Black Bear buys **Bill Hader**'s directing debut, the horror-thriller **They Know**, co-starring Linda Cardellini
items.summary_md: MRC fully financed it, and it is now in post-production.

items.headline_md: Magnolia buys the TIFF dramedy **Trash Mountain** (Caleb Hearon, Zooey Deschanel), set in **rural Missouri**
items.summary_md: A theatrical release is planned for next year; Colin Trevorrow produces.

items.headline_md: **Auli'i Cravalho** joins Amazon MGM and Miramax's new **Serendipity**, a modern update rather than a remake
items.summary_md: She joins Milo Manheim, Whitney Peak and Stephen Kalyn.

items.headline_md: Google brings **computer use** to the **Gemini app for Mac**, so it can work local apps, files and websites in the background
items.summary_md: It runs in an isolated window with a live preview, and you approve key actions.

items.headline_md: **Apple** appears to be building its own **computer-use AI agent**, going by a job listing
items.summary_md: Bloomberg also reports that macOS 27.3 makes it harder for third-party agents to take full control.

items.headline_md: **Microsoft** launches **seven MAI models** for coding, cybersecurity, images and real-time voice at lower prices
items.summary_md: MAI Code 2 is in GitHub Copilot, and MAI Realtime 1 is in limited preview.

items.headline_md: Google picks Blue Origin's **New Glenn** to launch **Project Suncatcher** AI-compute satellites in Q1 2029
items.summary_md: Each satellite will carry roughly a data-center rack of TPU computing.

items.headline_md: OpenAI's **GPT-Live-1.1** voice model is now in the **API**
items.summary_md: It improves accent consistency and task completion and adds a cheaper standby mode.

items.headline_md: The **European Commission** confirms an **AI-assisted cyberattack** that disrupted payroll and staff systems for over 10 days
items.summary_md: POLITICO says CERT-EU traced the open-source AI hacking platform ARTEX; the first signs appeared Oct. 22.

items.headline_md: App stores: Taiwan's FTC is reviewing **CyberLink**'s complaint that **Apple** unfairly terminated its developer account
items.summary_md: CyberLink puts the hit at $7.6M a year and wants its account restored and compensation.

items.headline_md: Design tools: **Canva** adds **AI Controls**, an off switch for generative AI and an option to see less AI content in its library
items.summary_md: Both are available now on Canva Free and Pro.

items.headline_md: Futures at 5:00 AM CT: **Nasdaq-100 −1%**, **S&P 500 −0.5%**, **Dow** just below flat
items.summary_md: This follows Thursday's 2%+ drop across all three indexes; Anthropic closed at $97, and Nvidia is extending a six-day slide.

items.headline_md: Asia and Europe at about 4:00 AM CT: **Taiwan −6.7%** (TSMC about −6%), **Nikkei −5%**, **Kospi −5.5%**, **SoftBank −14.5%**, **Stoxx 600 −1.3%**
items.summary_md: Asia is heading for its worst week since 2020.

items.headline_md: Oil at 10:04 PM CT Thu: **Brent $92.77 (+0.9%)**, **WTI Dec $83.46 (+0.3%)** after the Houthi strikes on Riyadh
items.summary_md: Both are still on track for a third straight weekly loss.

items.headline_md: Gold and crypto at 3:41 AM CT: **gold down nearly 3% to $3,514**, its lowest since early Sep 2025; **Bitcoin ~$61,900**
items.summary_md: Rising real yields are weighing on both; gold is down 15% and Bitcoin 28% this quarter.

sections.title: Weather
sections.body_md:
No ice storm or tornado threat for the St. Louis area in the next 7 days (NWS/SPC). There are no active NWS alerts at either point ([NWS alerts](https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=38.7875,-90.6299)), and NWS St. Louis lists no watches or advisories for MO or IL. SPC has no severe areas today; Saturday's marginal risk covers north Texas, western Oklahoma and central Kansas ([SPC Day 2](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day2otlk.html)); Sunday has no severe areas, with only scattered storms possible in the middle and lower Mississippi Valley ([SPC Day 3](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day3otlk.html)). The Day 4–8 outlook limits severe risk to the East Coast and Gulf Coast ([SPC Day 4–8](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/exper/day4-8/)). NWS St. Louis expects a cold front to bring near-100% odds of light rain Saturday night into Sunday, then 5–10° below normal by Tuesday. The 7-day forecasts for both cities mention no snow, sleet, freezing rain or thunder. A marginal elevated fire danger is possible this afternoon in parts of southeast Missouri and southern Illinois ([NWS St. Louis discussion](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=LSX&issuedby=LSX&product=AFD), 3:52 AM CT). I couldn't check the WPC winter outlooks or the LSX Hazardous Weather Outlook this morning (the HWO wasn't available through the NWS API).

items.headline_md: **St. Peters**: sunny, high near **74°**, clear tonight with a low around **48°**, 0% chance of rain all day; no active alerts
items.summary_md: Saturday is sunny and 73°; light rain moves in Saturday night into Sunday, then highs only in the 40s next week.

items.headline_md: **Berkeley**: sunny, high near **73°**, clear tonight with a low around **49°**, 0% chance of rain all day; no active alerts
items.summary_md: Same pattern: light rain Sunday, then a cool, sunny week with lows in the upper 20s to low 30s.

items.headline_md: **For the first time, the UN's top court finds a country responsible for genocide**
items.summary_md: AP's account explains what the Myanmar ruling means, and why it matters even though the ICJ can't enforce it.
